description: NaAsS₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six S²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-21°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.00 Å. As³⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three S²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of As-S bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.34 Å. There are two inequivalent S²⁻ sites. In the first S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent As³⁺ atoms. In the second S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and one As³⁺ atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₄As square pyramids.
